meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: Claude 会深入解释你遇到的任意 senpi 提示——启动提示、工作提示或 TUI 里的 Tip: 行,并始终用你提问时所用的语言回答,同时引用它真正读过的代码文件路径,而不是凭记忆复述提示原文。
howto.when: 当你问到某条 Tip: 行是什么意思、某个被提示功能怎么工作,或你这条会话能看到哪些提示时,它会接管。回答前它先运行列提示命令并读取你的 settings.json。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 行是什么意思?
say.note: 会先列出当前有效提示再解释这一条

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条提示背后是怎么实现的?
say.note: 会讲完整的回退架构流程并给出文件路径

say.text: 我这条会话里能看到哪些提示?
say.note: 会读你的 settings.json 判断哪些提示对你能出现

howto.what_en: Claude explains any senpi tip in depth — startup tips, working tips, or Tip: lines — always in the language you asked in. It first lists your live tips and reads your settings, then cites the code files it actually read instead of reciting the tip text.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask what a tip means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see. It runs the tip-listing command and reads your settings.json before explaining.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It lists your current tips first, then explains that one

say_en.text: How is the tip after a Fable 5 refusal implemented?
say_en.note: Walks the fallback-architect pipeline with file paths

say_en.text: Which tips can I see in this session?
say_en.note: Reads your settings.json to decide what can appear for you
